overview_description.description:
GoodData.AI is the AI-native, full-stack decision intelligence platform that helps businesses turn data into actionable, enterprise-grade insights. Build, operationalize, embed, and monetize trusted analytics, workflows, and AI agents at scale—fully governed, auditable, and ready to scale.

We serve all industries worldwide, from fintech and retail to healthcare, SaaS, and manufacturing. More than 123,000 organizations and 3.9 million users rely on GoodData.

about_short_description.short_description: GoodData.AI is an AI-native decision intelligence platform built to help enterprises turn trusted data into confident action.

product.name: GoodData Platform
product.description: An AI-native decision intelligence and analytics platform for connecting trusted data with dashboards, governed metrics, AI-assisted analysis, and embedded decision workflows.

product.name: Agentic Analytics
product.description: A platform capability for using AI agents to explore data, answer business questions, generate insights, and support decision-making within governed analytics environments.

product.name: Embedded Analytics
product.description: A development and delivery capability for integrating interactive dashboards, reports, and analytics into SaaS products, portals, and business applications.

product.name: Business Intelligence
product.description: A business intelligence offering for creating dashboards, reports, metrics, and visual analyses from governed enterprise data.

product.name: Analytics Lake
product.description: A governed analytics data layer for organizing, modeling, and serving data for business intelligence, AI-assisted analysis, and embedded analytics use cases.

product.name: AI Assistant
product.description: An AI-driven interface for asking questions about business data and receiving natural-language analytical responses based on governed metrics and data sources.
